item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 12/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure now affecting the coast of southern China will depart slightly today and tomorrow. Showers will lessen gradually over the region. The trough of low pressure is expected to edge closer to the coast of Guangdong again in the middle and latter parts of this week. The weather will be unsettled over the region. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening, showers will lessen over the coastal areas of Guangdong early next week.
